summary: Iteration 2 testing PASSED. New features (PUT /api/pagos/{id}, /api/users/list, created_by filter on pagos & reportes, hydrated created_by_name / edited_by_name, BusquedaPagos edit dialog + 'Registrado por' column + user filter, Reportes user filter) all working end-to-end. 50/50 backend pytest tests pass; UI verified for admin/caja/consultas roles.

issues: Date inputs use native browser date picker (input type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar — consistent with rest of app, low priority
Multiple users share the same display name (e.g. 'Test Caja' appears twice) because /api/users/list returns name only — consider showing role or email next to name to disambiguate

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines — consider splitting routers per resource (auth, users, estudiantes, tipospagos, pagos, reportes) for maintainability
/api/users/list returns all users including any future inactive ones — consider an is_active flag/filter when soft-delete is introduced
PUT /api/pagos/{id} returns 400 on 'no changes' which is correct, but frontend never sends an empty body (button disabled when no diff). Acceptable.
edited_by_name / created_by_name hydration adds N+1 user lookups per pago — fine for ≤1000 rows but if list size grows consider $lookup or batch fetch

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 2 features verified. Backend 50/50 pytest pass. Stable test users 'Caja UI' and 'Cons UI' exist for UI tests. /api/users/list returns duplicates with same name from previous test runs (TEST_caja_*, TEST_cons_*) — cosmetic only. Edit dialog flow: click [data-testid=edit-pago-btn-<id>] → fill [data-testid=edit-cantidad-input] → click [data-testid=edit-save-btn]. Role-based hiding of edit btn confirmed (caja/consultas see 0 edit buttons even though 9 non-anulado rows exist).
verified_features: GET /api/users/list returns [{id,name,role}] sorted by name, accessible to admin/caja/consultas, 401 unauth
PUT /api/pagos/{id} admin-only (403 for caja/consultas), 400 on anulado, 400 on no-changes, 404 not found, 400 on invalid estudiante/tipopago
PUT /api/pagos/{id} recalculates total when cantidad or tipopago (monto) changes; sets edited_at + edited_by
GET /api/pagos?created_by=<uid> returns only pagos created by that user
GET /api/reportes?created_by=<uid> filters report pagos by creator
BusquedaPagosPage: user filter dropdown loads from /api/users/list and applies on Buscar
BusquedaPagosPage: admin sees Pencil edit button per non-anulado row; caja/consultas see none; anulados never show edit
BusquedaPagosPage: edit dialog pre-loads cantidad+fecha, allows changing tipo+cantidad, saves, updates row total in-place, shows 'editado por <name>' subtitle
BusquedaPagosPage: table renders 'Registrado por' column with name + edited subtitle
ReportesPage: 'Registrado por (opcional)' Select renders with 'Todos los usuarios' default and user options
